unit: WF4 Approval Gate refuses a NONE channel as INVALID with no send path
description: An APPROVE decision whose action channel is NONE must return gate INVALID with a reason that names the channel, because only GMAIL has a send path and NONE must never be turned into one.
why_it_exists: Gate check 6 (send preconditions) of wf4/approval-gate.js requires common.channel to be GMAIL. AGENTS.md section 6 records a live defect: WF4 Verify Selected Row passed a gate channel of NONE against a register row saying GMAIL. The delivery-key families only supplied GMAIL actions, so the NONE channel path was unasserted. This pins that a NONE channel fails closed as INVALID and is never sent.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.note: Even in dry_run the gate must be INVALID: a NONE channel has no send path and the refusal must carry that fact. The delivery identity is derived but never sent.

assertions: an APPROVE whose action channel is NONE returns gate INVALID
the refusal names the channel and states that no send path exists
the delivery identity is derived for reporting but the gate is INVALID, never SEND
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
